registers.name: CTRL
registers.behavior: Byte 0 only; START reads zero. CTRL writes while busy return SLVERR. START clears prior terminal state and latches a valid descriptor.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.behavior: Read snapshot retained under R backpressure; writes return SLVERR.

registers.name: SRC_A
registers.behavior: Byte-strobe merge when idle; writes while busy return SLVERR.

registers.name: SRC_B
registers.behavior: Byte-strobe merge when idle; writes while busy return SLVERR.

registers.name: DST
registers.behavior: Byte-strobe merge when idle; destination must be 8-byte aligned and non-overlapping with inputs.

registers.name: LENGTH
registers.behavior: Byte-strobe merge when idle; accepted job length is 1 through MAX_LENGTH.

registers.name: ERROR_CODE
registers.behavior: 0 none, 1 descriptor, 2 DMA read, 3 DMA write. Writes return SLVERR.

registers.name: IRQ_ACK
registers.behavior: Byte 0 bit 0 clears pending; reads zero; a simultaneous new terminal event wins.
